mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits (HOUST) signals strong housing market activity, which is a leading indicator of consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) falls below 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals an aggressive monetary easing policy that reduces borrowing costs and stimulates economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS is below 4.5% for two consecutive months, the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer confidence and spending, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO), the S&P 500 tends to underperform as manufacturing slowdowns signal weakening corporate earnings; however, this effect is most pronounced in the early stages of a recession, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In early recession regimes (as defined by INDPRO declining for 3 consecutive months), the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) growth rate exceeds 0.5% month-over-month, it indicates robust consumer spending that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where RSAFS growth exceeds 0.5% MoM, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals a broad-based economic recovery, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST and RSAFS increases fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%), the S&P 500 tends to experience reduced volatility and positive returns as labor market tightness supports consumer spending; however, this effect is most pronounced when the unemployment rate is falling, leading to positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In low unemployment and declining regimes (UNRATE < 4.0% and UNRATE declining for 3 months), the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity, which is a leading indicator of corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average.
